import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.ros as ros

# 1. Initialize the Chrono engine
chrono.SetChronoDataPath("/path/to/chrono/data")  # Set to your Chrono data directory if needed

# Create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetIntegrationType(chrono.ChSystemNSC.IntegrationType.NONCONSTRAINT)
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# 2. Add terrain with specified properties
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
terrain.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod.SATURN)
terrain.Initialize(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
terrain.GetGround().SetFriction(0.8)
terrain.GetGround().SetRestitution(0.1)

# 3. Create the HMMWV vehicle
# Vehicle parameters
hmmwv = veh.HMMWV(system, veh.FULL, veh.HMMWV_LIGHT, veh.AIR_FILLED_TIRES)

# Set contact method (already set globally, but ensure vehicle uses same)
hmmwv.GetChassisBody().SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod.SATURN)

# Set engine type and tire model
hmmwv.SetEnginePower(86.0)  # Example power in HP
# Tire model, for example, RIGID tire
for tire in hmmwv.GetTireTerrainConnectors():
    tire.SetTireModel(veh.TireModel.RIGID)

# Initialize the vehicle
hmmwv.Initialize(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
hmmwv.GetPowertrain().SetDriveMode(veh.PowertrainModel.AD)
hmmwv.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.SHADOWS)

# 4. Set up the driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(hmmwv.GetSystem())
driver.SetSteeringUncertainty(0.01)
driver.SetThrottleUncertainty(0.01)
driver.SetBrakingUncertainty(0.01)

# 5. ROS Communication Setup
ros_manager = ros.ChROSmanager()

# Register clock handler
clock_handler = ros.ChROSClockHandler()
ros_manager.Register(clock_handler)

# Register driver input handler
driver_handler = ros.ChROSdriver(hmmwv)
ros_manager.Register(driver_handler)

# Register vehicle state publisher
vehicle_state_publisher = ros.ChROSvehicle(hmmwv)
ros_manager.Register(vehicle_state_publisher)

# 6. Simulation parameters
time_step = 1e-3  # 1 ms timestep
end_time = 10.0  # Run for 10 seconds

# Main simulation loop
current_time = 0.0
while current_time < end_time:
    # Synchronize ROS managers with current time
    ros_manager.Synchronize(current_time)
    
    # Advance the driver inputs
    driver.Synchronize(current_time)
    
    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
    
    # Apply driver inputs to vehicle
    hmmwv.GetPowertrain().Synchronize(current_time)
    hmmwv.GetPowertrain().SetThrottle(driver_inputs.m_throttle);
    hmmwv.GetPowertrain().SetBrake(driver_inputs.m_brake);
    hmmwv.GetSteering().SetSteeringAngle(driver_inputs.m_steering);
    hmmwv.GetSteering().Synchronize(current_time);
    
    # Advance the vehicle
    hmmwv.Synchronize(current_time)
    
    # Advance terrain
    terrain.Synchronize(current_time)
    terrain.Advance(time_step)
    
    # Advance the system physics
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
    
    # Update ROS with new state data
    ros_manager.Update(current_time)
    
    # Increment time
    current_time += time_step

    vis.AddCamera(chronoirr.ChVectorD(0, -20, 10))
    vis.AddTypicalLights()

    # Start the simulation loop.
    time = 0
    time_step = 1e-3  # Define the simulation time step.
    time_end = 30  # Set the total duration of the simulation.

    hmmwv.GetVehicle().EnableRealtime(True)  # Enable real-time simulation for the vehicle.
    while time < time_end:
        time = hmmwv.GetSystem().GetChTime()  # Update simulation time.

        # Get driver inputs and synchronize the vehicle, terrain, and driver systems.
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver.Synchronize(time)  # Synchronize the driver system.
        terrain.Synchronize(time)  # Synchronize the terrain.
        hmmwv.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)  # Synchronize the vehicle with inputs and terrain.

        # Advance the simulation for all modules by one timestep.
        driver.Advance(time_step)
        terrain.Advance(time_step)
        hmmwv.Advance(time_step)

        # Visualization rendering
        vis.Render()
        # Optionally add a delay if needed
        # chronoirr.ChTimerMs(10).Sleep()

        # Update the ROS manager to handle data publishing.
        if not ros_manager.Update(time, time_step):
            break  # Exit loop if ROS manager update fails.

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
